translations.autorizacion.tituloPestana: Authorize access to your data · Solventa
translations.autorizacion.errorCarga: We couldn't load the request. Check your connection and try again.
translations.autorizacion.noEncontrada.texto: Check the link you received or ask your advisor to send you a new request.
translations.autorizacion.origen: Request sent by {$INTERPOLATION}, from Solventa, on {$INTERPOLATION_1} at {$INTERPOLATION_2}
translations.autorizacion.casilla: I authorize Solventa to check my Open Finance and Open Data information to calculate my risk profile, under Law 1581 of 2012 and Decree 1297 of 2022, and I accept the data processing policy. I can revoke this authorization at any time.
translations.autorizacion.casilla.ayuda: To authorize, check the box. If you don't authorize, we won't check your data.
translations.autorizacion.errorEnvio: We couldn't save your answer. Try again.
translations.autorizacion.resultado.yaRespondida: This request has already been answered
translations.autorizacion.resultado.autorizada: You authorized access to your data
translations.autorizacion.resultado.noAutorizada: You didn't authorize access to your data
translations.autorizacion.resultado.asesorPuedeVer: Your advisor can now see your authorization and continue with your quote
translations.autorizacion.resultado.noContinua: The personalized quote won't continue; your advisor can send you a new request.
translations.autorizacion.dato.comportamientoPago.des: How you pay your loans and how much you owe today
translations.autorizacion.dato.estabilidadIngresos.de: How your income has changed over time
translations.autorizacion.dato.sociodemograficaTerrit: Socio-demographic and territorial information about your area
translations.autorizacion.dato.saludActuarialAgregada: Public health and aggregated actuarial data
Population indicators, not your medical history
translations.autorizacion.entidad.entidadesFinanzasAb: Financial institutions in the open finance scheme (simulated)
translations.autorizacion.entidad.minsalud: Ministry of Health and Social Protection
translations.autorizacion.condiciones.finalidad.perfi: To calculate your risk profile and the personalized price of your mortgage life insurance
translations.autorizacion.condiciones.destinatario.so: Solventa uses the result to calculate your premium. Your advisor sees the authorization status and the premium, not your data
translations.autorizacion.condiciones.comoRevocar: From “My authorizations”, whenever you want. We stop checking your data within 5 minutes at most and your active policies remain in force
translations.portal.noEncontrada.texto: Check the address or open the link you received again.
translations.perfilRiesgo.consulta.titulo: Look up the profile of an application
translations.perfilRiesgo.consulta.texto: It is the same risk profile used to price the quote the customer accepted. It is not recalculated.
translations.perfilRiesgo.consulta.invalido: Enter a valid application ID, such as 8e3b1f6a-2c4d-4e5f-9a7b-1c2d3e4f5a6b.
translations.perfilRiesgo.noEncontrada: We couldn't find an underwriting application with that ID.
translations.perfilRiesgo.noCoincide: The profile stored in the quote doesn't match the one in the application. Don't evaluate it and report it to support.
translations.perfilRiesgo.error: We couldn't load the profile. Try again.
translations.perfilRiesgo.motivo.sinCliente: The quote was priced without a risk profile because there was no identified customer.
translations.perfilRiesgo.motivo.sinConsentimiento: The quote was priced without a risk profile because the customer had no valid data authorization.
translations.perfilRiesgo.motivo.noDisponible: The quote was priced without a risk profile because the profile wasn't available in time.
translations.perfilRiesgo.valorPorDefecto: The premium was calculated with the insurance default value. Evaluate the application with that same value.
translations.cotizacion.formulario.ayuda.asesor: With these details and the customer's authorization, we calculate a personalized price based on their risk profile.
translations.cotizacion.formulario.ayuda.cliente: With these details and your authorization, we calculate a personalized price using your risk profile.
translations.cotizacion.busqueda.noEncontrado: We couldn't find a customer with that document.
translations.cotizacion.busqueda.error: We couldn't look up the customer. Try again.
translations.cotizacion.error.servidor: The service didn't accept this value. Please check it.
translations.cotizacion.error.documento.formatoPasapo: It must have 6 to 12 letters or numbers.
translations.cotizacion.error.plazo.formato: Enter a whole number of years.
translations.cotizacion.error.plazo.rango: It must be between 5 and 30 years.
translations.cotizacion.error.ciudad.largo: It must have between 2 and 80 characters.
translations.cotizacion.error.entidad.largo: It must have between 2 and 120 characters.
translations.cotizacion.caja.asesor.sinCliente: Look up the customer by their document to see the status of their authorization.
translations.cotizacion.caja.asesor.error: We couldn't check the customer's authorization.
translations.cotizacion.caja.asesor.autorizadaEl: The customer authorized access to their Open Finance and Open Data information on {$INTERPOLATION} at {$INTERPOLATION_1}.

translations.cotizacion.caja.asesor.esperando: We sent the authorization request to the customer and they haven't answered yet.
translations.cotizacion.caja.asesor.revocada: The customer revoked the authorization to access their information.
translations.cotizacion.caja.asesor.sinSolicitar: The customer hasn't authorized access to their Open Finance and Open Data information yet.
translations.cotizacion.caja.cliente.error: We couldn't check your authorization. You can still calculate: the premium will be calculated without your risk profile.

translations.cotizacion.caja.cliente.autorizada: Your authorization to access your Open Finance and Open Data information is active.
translations.cotizacion.caja.cliente.sinAutorizacion: You don't have an active authorization: we'll calculate the premium without your risk profile.
translations.cotizacion.bloqueo.cliente: To calculate, look up the customer by their document.
translations.cotizacion.bloqueo.autorizacion: To calculate, the customer must authorize access to their information.
translations.cotizacion.error.servicio: We couldn't calculate the quote. Your details are still here: try again.
translations.cotizacion.error.rechazada: The service didn't accept some details. Check the marked fields.
translations.cotizacion.panel.sinPerfil.sinCliente: Calculated without a risk profile because there is no identified customer.

Calculated without your risk profile because it wasn't available in time.

translations.cotizacion.asesor.aviso.reenviada: We resent the authorization request to the customer.
translations.cotizacion.asesor.aviso.error: We couldn't send the authorization request. Try again.
translations.oferta.error: We couldn't load the offer. Try again.
translations.oferta.porque.asesor: Why the client got this price
translations.oferta.senales.asesor: Risk profile signals, calculated with the client's authorization.
translations.oferta.senales.cliente: Your risk profile signals, calculated with your authorization.
translations.oferta.valorPorDefecto: The premium uses the insurance's default value, with no profile-based discounts or surcharges.
translations.oferta.fuentes: Sources: Open Finance and Open Data. If a source doesn't respond in time, the premium is calculated with the default value and noted here.
translations.oferta.vencida.aviso: This offer expired on {$INTERPOLATION}. Get a new quote for a current premium.
translations.oferta.continuar.asesor: The client accepts · send to underwriting
translations.suscripcion.texto.asesor: The client accepted the offer. The next step, the evaluation with the underwriting rules, isn't available in the portal yet.
translations.suscripcion.texto.cliente: You chose to continue with your offer. The next step, the evaluation of your application, isn't available in the portal yet.

translations.ingreso.sinCuenta: Don't have a customer account yet?

translations.ingreso.error.bloqueo: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
translations.ingreso.error.sinPortal: Your user doesn't have a portal assigned. Contact the administrator.
translations.ingreso.aviso.inactividad: Your session was closed due to inactivity.
translations.ingreso.aviso.expirada: Your session expired. Sign in again.
translations.ingreso.error.correo.formato: Enter a valid email, such as name@email.com.

translations.crearCuenta.politica: At least 12 characters, with uppercase letters, lowercase letters and numbers.
translations.crearCuenta.leyDatos: Your data is encrypted and processed under Colombian Law 1581 of 2012.
translations.crearCuenta.codigo.ayuda: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {$START_TAG_STRONG}{$INTERPOLATION}{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}.
translations.crearCuenta.aviso.sinConfirmar: Your email isn't confirmed yet. We sent you a new code.
translations.crearCuenta.aviso.reenviado: We sent you a new code.
translations.crearCuenta.error.correoExiste: An account with that email already exists. Sign in with your password.
translations.crearCuenta.error.contrasenaInvalida: The password must have at least 12 characters, with uppercase letters, lowercase letters and numbers.
translations.crearCuenta.error.codigoVencido: The code expired. Request a new one.
translations.crearCuenta.error.demasiadosIntentos: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
translations.crearCuenta.error.cuentaNoEnlazable: We couldn't create your account with those details. If you already signed up in the app, use the same email; otherwise, contact your advisor.
translations.crearCuenta.error.noDisponible: Creating an account isn't available in this environment.
translations.crearCuenta.error.servidor: The service didn't accept this value. Check it.
translations.crearCuenta.error.documento.formatoPasap: It must have 6 to 12 letters or numbers.
translations.crearCuenta.error.nombre.largo: It must have between 2 and 60 characters.
translations.crearCuenta.error.nombre.formato: Use only letters, separated by a space, an apostrophe or a hyphen.
translations.crearCuenta.error.celular.formato: It must have 10 digits and start with 3, with no country code or spaces.
translations.crearCuenta.error.correo.formato: Enter a valid email, such as name@email.com.
